title: Enhanced Recipes
description: Enhanced recipes adds a ton of new must have recipes into Minecraft such as bulkcrafting and faster recepies etc
body:
# Enhanced Recipes
Enhanced recipes adds a ton of new must have recipes into Minecraft!

**These recepies are now craftable with any type of stone, not just cobblestone!**
<details>
<summary>Any Stone Recipes</summary>
  Available Stone Types:

Stone ![Stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfd0057adbdc7338377465b843d475b577c58efc.png)  Cobblestone ![Cobblestone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf009cfed85345e275e2952c3c2686a70885e6b6.png)  Andesite ![Andesite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/321f10935fd34e8c0e81dec47f25eca6c6a5f1f7.png)  Diorite ![Diorite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c76fef801da7b088dbbf2b892a09f91b8ea04e57.png)  Granite ![Granite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af2518fc3822d9d2909c1c405e9e8aa6210581be.png)

Tuff ![Tuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50e14a34dfc589f2ddfa93afaf0c9ec6767f3ed9.png)  Deepslate ![Deepslate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/914ce544288dfa8c95887ac9b485df93b77fbe31.png)  Cobbled Deepslate ![Cobbled Deepslate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66baceb5cfa84c95dd148f6d723eb9e4fb217c62.png)  Blackstone ![Blackstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/610c475abce4e24e5d34b7d6c83ec581355f5b0f.png)

**These recipes are now craftable with any stained glass as well, not just regular glass!**

<details>
<summary>Any Glass Recipe</summary>

Bottle

Daylight Detector

</details>

**Some bulk-crafting recipes has been added for faster crafting**
<details>
<summary>Bulk Recipes</summary>

Bowl:
Use Log or Wood instead of Planks to get 16x Bowls

Chest:
Use Log or Wood instead of Planks to get 4x Chest

Cauldron:
Use Block Of Iron instead of Iron Ingot to get 12x Cauldron

Chain:
Use Iron Ingot instead of Iron Nugget to get 9x Chain

Iron Door:
Use Block Of Iron instead of Iron Ingot to get 27x Iron Door

Iron Trap Door:
Use Block Of Iron instead of Iron Ingot to get 9x Iron Trap Door

Heavy Weighted Pressure Plate:
Use Block Of Iron instead of Iron Ingot to get 9x Heavy Weighted Pressure Plate

Light Weighted Pressure Plate:
Use Gold Block instead of Gold Ingot to get 9x Light Weighted Pressure Plate

Sticks:
Use Log or Wood instead of Planks to get 16x Stick

Bread:
Use Hay Bale instead of Wheat to get 9x Bread

Bucket:
Use Block Of Iron instead of Iron Ingot to get 9x Bucket

Compass:
Use Block Of Iron and Redstone Block instead of Iron Ingot and Redstone to get 9x Compass

Piston:
Use Block Of Iron and Redstone Block instead of Iron Ingot and Redstone to get 8x Piston

Torch:
Use Log or Wood instead of Planks to get 32X Torch
</details>

> Any glass except Tinted Glass now drops a Glass Shard that you can use to craft a new glass block in a 2x2 area

> **More has been added, info coming soon!**
